capabilities: turn a folder of notes into a flashcard deck with its own schedule and new-card budget
review due and new cards by flipping and rating Again/Hard/Good/Easy
schedule card due dates with SM-2-style intervals written to frontmatter
read card fronts and backs aloud with tagged text-to-speech phrases
open several decks side by side in separate tabs
disambiguation: Not a text-swiping or gesture tool; the swiping is just the review interaction for spaced-repetition flashcard decks.
extras: Review history is not persisted yet; the README lists this under known limitations. The README also includes developer release instructions rather than user troubleshooting.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in flashcard or spaced-repetition review, so notes cannot be scheduled and quizzed as cards out of the box.

relations.evidence: A Tinder/Anki-style flashcard view for Obsidian.

summary: Flashcard view that turns each note in a folder into a card, with swipe/tap review, SM-2 spaced repetition scheduling, and text-to-speech.
